mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained inflation spike (CPIAUCSL crossing above 200) triggers investor concerns about tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite CPIAUCSL crossing above 200, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-month period.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS above 4.5%), rising rates increase discount rates on equities, compressing future cash flows and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative in tightening regime, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in unemployment (UNRATE below 4%) signals labor market weakening, reducing consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative despite UNRATE < 4%, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 6-month period.

mechanism_narrative: An expansion in supply (INDPRO crossing above 105) reduces upward pressure on prices, lowering inflation expectations and encouraging equity investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive despite INDPRO crossing above 105, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in demand (GDPC1) and improvement in labor conditions (UNRATE decline) signals robust economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive despite GDPC1 up and UNRATE down, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 > 17,000 and UNRATE < 4.5%), heightened demand and labor market strength create sustained growth in corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive in late-cycle expansion despite GDPC1 >17,000 and UNRATE <4.5%, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 1-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in demand (HOUST crossing above 1,100) indicates rapid consumer spending, prompting market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive despite HOUST crossing above 1,100, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 1-month period.
